paper_title: Boosting Highly Effcient Hydrocarbon Solvent-Processed AllPolymer-Based Organic Solar Cells by Modulating Thin-Film Morphology

knowledge_points.content: The toluene-processed PM6:PY-IT all-polymer organic solar cell achieved a power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 15.51%, which was higher than the 15.00% PCE achieved by the chloroform-processed device.
knowledge_points.evidence: toluene-processed PM6:PYIT-based solar cells provided an excellent PCE of 15.51%, the best value for hydrocarbon solvent-processed PD:PA based OSCs, meanwhile surpassing that of CF (15.00%).

knowledge_points.content: The optimal processing condition for the toluene-based PM6:PY-IT blend involved heating the solution and the substrates to 95 °C during film formation.
knowledge_points.evidence: we hereby chose to cast from a toluene blend solution when it was heated at 95 °C and the substrates were also preheated at this temperature, imitating the film formation of CF-cast ones.

knowledge_points.content: GIWAXS analysis revealed that toluene-cast films exhibit lower crystallinity compared to chloroform-cast films, with crystal correlation lengths (CCL) for π-π stacking reducing from 24.2 Å (CF) to 21.1 Å (toluene).
knowledge_points.evidence: The π-π stacking peaks... with CCLs of 24.2 and 21.1 Å for CF and toluene, respectively. These results imply that the film cast from toluene has weaker crystallinity.

knowledge_points.content: Despite having lower crystallinity, the toluene-processed active layer exhibited higher charge mobilities (hole mobility of 9.22 × 10⁻⁴ cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹ and electron mobility of 5.56 × 10⁻⁴ cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹) compared to chloroform-processed films.
knowledge_points.evidence: The μh values of CF and toluene films are 8.31 and 9.22 × 10⁻⁴ cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹ while their μe values are 4.76 and 5.56 × 10⁻⁴ cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹, respectively... the toluene-processed active layer shows enhanced charge transport, although its thin-film crystallinity is weakened.

knowledge_points.content: TEM imaging indicated that the toluene-processed films contain fewer large phases but higher domain purity, which is identified as the reason for enhanced charge transport despite reduced overall crystallinity.
knowledge_points.evidence: The images in Figure S1 show that the toluene-processed film contains fewer large phases but purer, which contributes to charge transport enhancement.

knowledge_points.content: The charge collection efficiency (ηcoll) was improved from 79.4% in chloroform-processed devices to 81.8% in toluene-processed devices.
knowledge_points.evidence: The (ηdiss, ηcoll)s for CF and toluene devices are (91.6%, 79.4%) and (92.6%, 81.8%), respectively: a better charge extraction takes place in the toluene-processed device.

knowledge_points.content: Toluene processing suppresses trap-state recombination in PM6:PY-IT devices, evidenced by a lower ideality factor (n) of 1.14 compared to 1.20 for chloroform-processed devices.
knowledge_points.evidence: The fitted n values for devices cast from CF and toluene are 1.20 and 1.14, respectively, meaning Rt,s takes a less dominant position in toluene film.

knowledge_points.content: The toluene-processed PM6:PY-IT device demonstrated a short-circuit current density (Jsc) of 22.52 mA cm⁻² and a fill factor (FF) of 73.8%.
knowledge_points.evidence: toluene-processed PM6:PY-IT-based cells showed a PCE as high as 15.51%, contributed by enhanced Jsc (22.52 mA cm⁻²) and FF (73.8%).

knowledge_points.content: PM6:PY-IT devices processed with toluene exhibited improved operational photostability under 1 sun illumination in air compared to those processed with chloroform.
knowledge_points.evidence: The toluene-cast device exhibits improved stability under standard illumination in air compared to the CF-processed device.

knowledge_points.content: AFM measurements showed that toluene-cast films have a lower root mean square (RMS) roughness of 1.23 nm compared to 1.51 nm for chloroform-cast films, leading to better interface charge extraction.
knowledge_points.evidence: the AFM height image of the CF-cast film delivers a 1.51 nm root mean square (RMS), while that of the toluene-cast film is 1.23 nm... Smoother surface of the toluene film might lead to more efficient charge extraction at interface.

knowledge_points.content: UV-vis-NIR absorption spectra indicated that toluene processing induces a slight blue-shift in the absorption edge and a lower peak at 808 nm for PY-IT, suggesting weaker aggregation compared to chloroform processing.
knowledge_points.evidence: Compared with CF, toluene induces a slightly blue-shifted edge and lower peak at 808 nm, implying that the aggregation of PY-IT is weaker.
